experiments.study_type: RapidCaP prostate cancer model: intra-prostate Cre/Luciferase lentivirus injection in Pten/Trp53/tdTomato mice with STPT 3D imaging of tumor initiation and metastasis
experiments.procedure_text: Intra-prostate injection of concentrated Cre/Luciferase lentivirus into right anterior prostate of Pten/Trp53/tdTomato mice; tumor initiation and metastasis imaged by bioluminescence and STPT.
experiments.procedure_text_evidence: 20 μL of the concentrated virus was injected into the right anterior prostate
experiments.animal_counts_evidence: five, seven, five, and five mice analyzed at days 5, 10, 20, and 50
experiments.test_system_evidence: In vivo and ex-vivo, bioluminescence imaging was performed
experiments.route_evidence: injected into the right anterior prostate

endpoints.label: Prostate cancer initiation and tumor focus volume
endpoints.evidence: Reconstruction and volume quantification of tdT + foci in prostate

endpoints.label: Distant metastasis to liver and brain
endpoints.evidence: Mapping 3D distribution of PC metastatic cells in the liver

endpoints.label: Nuclear size of epithelial/metastatic cells
endpoints.evidence: Quantification of the increase in nuclear size of tdT +

substances.name: Luc. Cre lentiviral plasmid (LV-Cre/Luci)
substances.evidence: the Luc. Cre lentiviral plasmid (Tyler Jacks, Addgene plasmid 20905)

substances.name: luciferin
substances.evidence: intraperitoneal injections of 200 mg/kg luciferin 10 minutes before imaging

experiments.exposure_evidence: Typically, 20 μL of the concentrated virus was injected into the right anterior prostate
experiments.regulatory_evidence: approved by the Institutional Animal Care and Use Committee (IACUC)
experiments.notes: Two injection routes present: intra-prostate lentivirus (route 'other') and intraperitoneal luciferin. Distant metastasis analysis used 15-month-old mice; imaging timepoints 5-50 days post-injection.
